p: This end of Bethnal Green Road is proper East End: market stalls, caffs, barbers and a constant stream of buses heading for Shoreditch or Cambridge Heath.

Admiral is an adults-only gaming centre, so it's one for grown-ups on their own time. If you're making more of a trip of it, the Young V&A, the old Museum of Childhood, is a short walk away by Bethnal Green station and is brilliant for families. Head west along the road and you'll end up near Brick Lane for curries and bagels, and on a Sunday morning Columbia Road's flower market is close enough to wander to. Plenty of reasons to be in the area, with or without a spin on the machines.
